items.claim: Marco Maderos had to resort to elbows because his straight shots were smothered by Taco Padilla's pressure.
items.quote: he had to move to the elbows. I think that the elbows could serve him well here against someone who pressures as much as Mason Jones

items.claim: Mason Jones is extremely hittable and lacks care for defense or head movement.
items.quote: someone who is as extremely hitable as Mason Jones and he doesn't have so much care for the defense or the head movement.

items.claim: Mason Jones has very good counters and hits pretty hard.
items.quote: Mason Jones has very good counters. He's a little bit underrated to that degree. He's got very good counters and hits pretty hard.

items.claim: Mason Jones is extremely tough and not much of a round one finisher.
items.quote: Mason Jones is extremely tough and I don't think he's much of a round one finisher.

items.claim: Mason Jones has extremely more damaging boxing than Chris Padilla.
items.quote: The big difference between Chris Padilla and Mason Jones is that Mason Jones has extremely more damaging boxing than Chris Padilla.

items.claim: Jackson McVey has way more tools, is more dangerous in the clinch, and is a faster starter than Wes Schulz.
items.quote: I think Jackson has way more tools. You know, he's way more dangerous in the clinch. He's a lot more of a fast starter.

items.claim: Wes Schulz is a much higher level grappler than Jackson McVey.
items.quote: Overall though, I think where Schultz is a much higher level grappler than him.

items.claim: Wes Schulz has almost nothing on the feet and gasses out very badly in fights.
